scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join('dist','db');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});const m=p.join(d,'migrations');fs.mkdirSync(m,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(p.join('src','db','migrations'),m,{recursive:true});const src=p.join('src','db','schema.sql');if(fs.existsSync(src))fs.copyFileSync(src,p.join(d,'schema.sql'));console.log('Build complete with migrations')"
